fonts.display: 'Agrandir', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Signal Red
palette.role: Primary CTA fill, nav active state, brand logo, emphasis body text, accent box-shadows on interactive elements — the single chromatic voice of the system, reserved for moments of decision and identity

palette.name: Carbon Ink
palette.role: Primary text, heading text on light surfaces, icon strokes, nav text, button text, all structural borders and dividers

palette.name: Summit White
palette.role: Primary page canvas, card surface, button text on red, input fill, nav background, hero foreground text on dark imagery

palette.name: Ridge Gray
palette.role: Input border, subtle form dividers — the only non-black neutral, used where a softer boundary is needed without losing contrast
